turns.patient_response: I’ve been really stuck on how I look, especially my face, and it’s getting harder to ignore. I keep thinking there’s something really wrong with it, even though people tell me it looks fine, and it’s starting to affect my day-to-day life.

symptom_reasoning.S067: The patient is preoccupied with perceived defects in their face, believing something is really wrong despite reassurance from others and noting that this is affecting daily life, consistent with appearance-focused preoccupation.
